source: Wikipedia: Minimum wage in the United States (state tables, cross-checked citations), Sep 2026

Alabama.note: No state minimum; federal $7.25 applies to workers covered by FLSA.

California.note: $16.90 state minimum; some cities and counties set higher local rates.

Georgia.note: State law sets $5.15; most employers are covered by the federal $7.25 minimum.

Louisiana.note: No state minimum; federal $7.25 applies to workers covered by FLSA.

Minnesota.note: $11.41 for large employers; small-employer and youth rates are lower.

Mississippi.note: No state minimum; federal $7.25 applies to workers covered by FLSA.

Nevada.note: $12.00; employers offering qualifying health insurance may apply a lower tier — verify current rules.

New Jersey.note: $15.92 standard; $14.20 agricultural. Seasonal/small-employer rules may differ.

South Carolina.note: No state minimum; federal $7.25 applies to workers covered by FLSA.

Tennessee.note: No state minimum; federal $7.25 applies to workers covered by FLSA.

Wyoming.note: State law sets $5.15; most employers are covered by the federal $7.25 minimum.
